title: Tricks
author: Ellen Hopkins
current_text: On May 30, 2025, the South Carolina State Board of Education ordered Tricks removed from all public schools in South Carolina under a regulation excluding materials containing descriptions or visual depictions of sexual conduct.

sources.quote:
Order No. 2025-0016
May 30, 2025
s/Rita Allison ______________________
Rita Allison
Chair
South Carolina State Board of Education
May 30, 2025

Order 2025-0016: Tricks – Ellen Hopkins
Under the State Board’s rulings, these materials must be immediately removed from all public schools in South Carolina. Please review the State Board’s written orders for further clarification on these items.

As per Regulation 43-170, materials containing “descriptions or visual depictions of ‘sexual conduct’” are not deemed “Age and Developmentally Appropriate” for any age group. Therefore, such materials must be removed from all school libraries, classroom libraries, and other areas on campus where they may be accessible to students.
